map.point: One point per primary source: a catalogue record whose primary URL equals the primary URL of the bundle card it belongs to is drawn once, as that bundle card, which carries the date.
map.fresh_rule: Fresh means first public on or after 15 October 2026: a dated record on or after 2026-10-15, or a record dated only to a month from November 2026 on. A record dated only to October 2026 is not marked.
